transcript.text: Thanks for meeting with me. Can you walk me through your week?
Sure. Most of my day is claims. Every Friday I export the claims list to Excel for the practice manager.
If it needs prior auth I put the number in the notes, or sometimes just see fax.
If a claim sits pending more than 30 days I phone the payer and write it on a sticky note.

played.text: Where does the prior auth number go today?
What happens when a claim gets stuck?
